reviewedServiceBlocks.frontend:
image: imperator/frontend:${IMPERATOR_IMAGE_TAG:?Set IMPERATOR_IMAGE_TAG to the current Git SHA}
    platform: linux/amd64
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/frontend/Dockerfile
      args:
        VCS_REF: ${IMPERATOR_IMAGE_TAG:?Set IMPERATOR_IMAGE_TAG to the current Git SHA}
    environment:
      HOSTNAME: 0.0.0.0
      IMPERATOR_API_ORIGIN: http://backend:8080
      IMPERATOR_RUNTIME_PROFILE: docker-compose
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "3000"
    networks:
      - application-internal
      - frontend-ingress
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - 127.0.0.1:${IMPERATOR_HTTP_PORT:-3000}:3000
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - node
        - -e
        - >-
          fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/').then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) process.exit(1)
          }).catch(() => process.exit(1))
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=32m,mode=1777
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cpus: 0.5
    mem_limit: 512m
    pids_limit: 100
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 10m
        max-file: "3"
reviewedServiceBlocks.postgres:
image: imperator/postgres:${IMPERATOR_IMAGE_TAG:?Set IMPERATOR_IMAGE_TAG to the current Git SHA}
    platform: linux/amd64
    build:
      context: ./postgresql
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        VCS_REF: ${IMPERATOR_IMAGE_TAG:?Set IMPERATOR_IMAGE_TAG to the current Git SHA}
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: imperator
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: --auth-host=scram-sha-256
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/postgres-owner-password
      POSTGRES_USER: imperator_owner
    secrets:
      - postgres-owner-password
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql
    networks:
      - data-internal
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready --host=127.0.0.1 --username=imperator_owner --dbname=imperator
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 20s
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=16m,mode=1777
      - /var/run/postgresql:size=16m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0775
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - CHOWN
      - DAC_OVERRIDE
      - FOWNER
      - SETGID
      - SETUID
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cpus: 1.0
    mem_limit: 1024m
    pids_limit: 200
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 10m
        max-file: "3"

evidenceInput: EvidenceController consumes application/x-ndjson; importer decodes UTF-8 and parses JSON. raw_payload is bounded metadata, not an uploaded disk image.
componentPresence: Trivy identifies libblkid1 2.38.1-5+deb12u3 in both exact Debian images. Treat as affected; no claim the library is absent or never executable.
reachabilityAssessment: No direct block-partition utility invocation or raw-device pass-through identified in reviewed source/configuration. A crafted regular disk image can still reach the parser if a local/compromised actor invokes libblkid; capabilities do not prevent the parsing bug itself.
reviewLimit: Static review, no complete transitive native callgraph, no live runtime or exploit test. Assumptions must be checked in any future runtime override.
